column1: # Chrome, through `just conformance`: whether `direction` reaches a box that does not state one.
# Measured on Chrome Headless Shell 153.0.8010.12, the chromium Playwright pins here.
# Box cases: a 100x20 page holding a 60x20 box 20px in from its left,
# with two 30px slots -- grid tracks or fixed-width flex items -- red then blue.
# Block cases: a 30x20 block child of the same page, directly or through a block.
# Text cases: a 300x60 page holding one line "abc" of Fixture at 32px.
# Written by packages/meo-canvas/tools/conformance/directioninherit.mjs.
# `first,second` is each slot child's left edge from the page, in document
# order; `left` is the block child's left edge; `left,width` is the inked
# columns of the line. A direction is on the page, on the box, on both or on
# neither, as the case says.
